title: RetrievalEvalQuestion
description: One row of eval/retrieval/questions.jsonl. The Phase 3.2 retrieval eval scores each question against the chunked corpus by hit@1 / hit@5 / MRR; a chunk counts as a hit when its (doc_id, page_range) intersects the expected span and it contains all expected_span_keywords. Questions with expected_no_hit=true invert the scoring: a 'hit' means no top-k chunk contains all keywords (used for negative-case Qs whose answer is genuinely not in the corpus).

id.description: Sequential id like 'q001'. Stable across edits; never recycle.

question.description: Natural-language question a clinician might ask.

expected_doc_id.description: doc_id of the source document containing the answer. For expected_no_hit=true questions, this is a sentinel and is ignored by the scorer.

expected_page_range.description: [page_start, page_end] inclusive 1-indexed. For expected_no_hit=true questions, ignored by the scorer.

expected_span_keywords.description: Keywords that must appear in a retrieved chunk's text for it to count as a hit (case-insensitive substring match, whitespace collapsed). For expected_no_hit=true questions, no top-k chunk should contain all keywords for the question to be a hit.

rationale.description: Why this question was chosen; what the right answer looks like.

source_phase.description: Phase that authored the question. 3.1 ships the seed; 3.2 expands to 50.

requires_full_corpus.description: If true, the question targets the real RACGP/NVDPA PDFs and is skipped in --use-fixture mode.

expected_no_hit.description: Negative-case flag (Phase 3.2). If true, the question's answer is genuinely not in the corpus; the scorer awards a hit when no top-k chunk contains all expected_span_keywords. Use sparingly; the keywords should be discriminative enough that they would only appear in a confidently-wrong retrieval.

tags.description: Closed-set taxonomy locked in Phase 3.2. Phase 3.2's per-tag subgroup metrics depend on this being a controlled vocabulary.
